component.name: Tabchat
component.summary: WhatsApp, Discord, Teams, Outlook and OneDrive in one window

description.p: Tabchat puts your chat and work apps in one lightweight window with tabs, sharing a single browser engine instead of running a separate app for each service.
It adds the desktop features the web versions are missing:

ul.li: Unread counters on every tab, in the tray icon and on the dock icon
Keeps running in the background with a tray icon
Do not disturb, and it follows the Do not disturb setting of your desktop
Clicking a notification opens the right tab
One shared Microsoft sign-in for Teams, Outlook and OneDrive that stays signed in
Tab sleep: unused tabs are unloaded from memory and return with one click
Quick search with Ctrl+K and browser-style keyboard shortcuts
Screen sharing in Discord and Teams, also on Wayland
Light and dark theme that follows your system
Choose where links open: your default browser, a specific browser or Tabchat itself
English and Dutch

description.p: Tabchat is an independent project and is not affiliated with WhatsApp, Meta, Discord or Microsoft. It shows the official web versions of these services and collects no data.

A "What's new" window after every update.
